answer: SybilGuard: 1) Stake $5 collateral per identity. 2) Require 10 established connections to vouch. 3) If a vouched identity is Sybil, both lose collateral, cascading 3 degrees. Cost for N identities: $5N. The initial staked identities form a critical ridge. A hollow in connections enables Sybil networks. Failure occurs if a coordinated group colludes to vouch for many Sybils, overwhelming slashing. This is like a rotten log; a few termites at the nadir can hollow out the entire structure.
